executive_summary: Across 57,865 orders the platform cancelled 5,188 of them — a 8.97% cancellation rate, and the trend is easing. The largest single addressable driver is "items out of stock at vendor" at 903 cancellations (17.4% of all cancellations). The steepest concentration is late night orders in Al Khor, where supply, not demand, is the binding constraint.

top_drivers.name: Items out of stock at vendor
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 903 cancelled orders (17.4% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Mandate real-time stock sync for the top grocery and market partners, and offer substitutions at checkout instead of cancelling.

top_drivers.name: Customer changed mind
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 656 cancelled orders (12.6% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Show a live prep/ETA bar from the moment of ordering — most change-of-mind cancels land in the first five minutes.

top_drivers.name: Vendor not answering
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 623 cancelled orders (12.0% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Auto-page vendors that haven't accepted within 5 minutes, and pause merchants after two consecutive non-responses.

top_drivers.name: Ordered by mistake
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 571 cancelled orders (11.0% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Add a 10-second grace window and a duplicate-order prompt when the same basket is re-submitted.

top_drivers.name: No driver available
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 526 cancelled orders (10.1% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Pre-position couriers in the late-night zones and raise incentives before the 22:00 supply dip, not after it.

top_drivers.name: Delivery time too long
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 447 cancelled orders (8.6% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Cap promised ETAs per zone at the p80 actual, and surface a courier-shortage banner before checkout.

top_drivers.name: Vendor closed
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 340 cancelled orders (6.6% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Reconcile listed opening hours against actual accept behaviour weekly and auto-hide vendors that miss their own window.

top_drivers.name: Wrong delivery address
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 300 cancelled orders (5.8% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Force an address confirmation step for first-time drop-off points and pin-drop verification outside mapped zones.

top_drivers.name: Payment failed
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 294 cancelled orders (5.7% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Retry the authorisation once before cancelling, and fall back to cash-on-delivery where the zone allows it.

top_drivers.name: Duplicate order
top_drivers.explanation: Recorded on 221 cancelled orders (4.3% of all cancellations).
top_drivers.recommendation: Deduplicate identical baskets from the same customer inside a 5-minute window at the API layer.

high_risk_segments.recommendation: Audit courier supply and vendor accept times in Al Khor; it runs 5.4 points above the platform average.
Audit courier supply and vendor accept times in Umm Salal; it runs 3.72 points above the platform average.
Audit courier supply and vendor accept times in Al Wakrah; it runs 2.9 points above the platform average.
Late Night is the weakest slot of the day — staff couriers to it before raising vendor targets.
Health & Wellness cancels most often; start with stock accuracy at its highest-volume merchants.

trend_insight: Monthly cancellation rate over the last six months: 8.6%, 9.0%, 9.45%, 9.61%, 9.13%, 7.67%. The rate is easing while order volume grows, so the remaining cancellations are concentrated causes rather than broad degradation.
